rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for the quality of being timely, especially in formal or written contexts.

example.english: The timeliness of this project directly affects its effectiveness.
example.traditional: 呢個項目嘅及時性，直接影響成效。
example.jyutping: nei1 go3 hong6 muk6 ge3 kap6 si4 sing3 zik6 zip3 jing2 hoeng2 sing4 haau6

rows.note: Use this mainly for the timeliness of information, services, or responses rather than punctuality in general.

example.english: When the government releases information, timeliness is the most important thing.
example.traditional: 政府公布資料，最重要係確保資訊嘅時效性。
example.jyutping: zing3 fu2 gung1 bou3 zi1 liu2 zeoi3 zung6 jiu3 hai6 kok3 bou2 zi1 seon3 ge3 si4 haau6 sing3
